title: Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries as first Black House speaker despite progressives’ concerns
summary_full: Jeffries is set to become one of Trump’s most prominent opponents for final two years of his presidencyUS politics live – latest updatesDemocrats on Wednesday resoundingly nominated Hakeem Jeffries to serve as speaker of the House when the new Congress begins next year, teeing him up to become the first Black lawmaker to lead the chamber.A New York congressman who has served as the Democratic minority leader since 2023, Jeffries is set to become one of Donald Trump’s most prominent opponents for the final two years of his presidency, when Democrats will control both the Senate and House of Representatives and are expected to undertake aggressive efforts to check his powers.
